narrative.overview:
ActForGoa feels like a useful local field guide: calm, welcoming, and grounded in the place and people it serves. Warm paper and deep green give practical information a steady home. Upright editorial headings add character, while clear humanist text keeps searching, scanning, and reading straightforward.

Real Goan photographs supply the visual richness. Open lists, restrained borders, and pale green surfaces organise the information without making every section a card. Controls are simple and gently rounded. Source dates, historical context, and contact caveats sit close to the material they qualify.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper, forest green, and restrained sun yellow.
Upright Literata headings with Manrope controls and body text.
Real local photographs, with their source context retained.
Open index rows, quiet cards, and generous reading space.
Visible source context and honest interaction states.

rules.name: The Functional Accent Rule
rules.body: Use yellow for the search action and green for primary actions or selected filters. Use pale surfaces to group supporting information; do not use colour to imply that a contact is currently verified.

rules.name: The Upright Type Rule
rules.body: Keep every letter upright, including the wordmark, headings, quotes, labels, and decorative text. Use weight, size, and space for emphasis.

rules.name: The Mobile Reading Rule
rules.body: At widths up to 850px, keep search text at 16px, explanatory summaries and verification notices at 14px, and the documented status, byline, metadata, filter, and provenance roles at 12px. Let content grow vertically.

rules.name: The Source Proximity Rule
rules.body: Keep the source link, publication context, or availability caveat beside the record or contact it qualifies. Do not hide essential context to preserve a card height.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Cards and content surfaces remain shadowless. The sole implemented shadow identifies the expanded mobile navigation as a layer above the page.

rules.name: The Structural Line Rule
rules.body: Use a full border or a horizontal divider to express a real boundary. Never place a decorative accent stripe along a container edge.

rules.name: The Honest State Rule
rules.body: Keep search progress, fallback, empty results, historical contact status, and prepared-email feedback explicit. A prepared email is not a sent message.

dos: Do preserve the warm paper, forest green, and real local photography.
Do use the existing upright type families and let long content reflow.
Do preserve the final mobile search, supporting-text, and metadata sizes.
Do keep source context, dates, and contact caveats readable beside the relevant content.
Do provide visible keyboard focus and retain reduced-motion behavior.
Do use plain dividers and whole-surface fills for real structure.
donts: Don't use italic or oblique styling anywhere, including wordmarks or quotations.
Don't add decorative side stripes to cards, notices, quotes, or other containers.
Don't replace local photography with fabricated scenes or decorative imitation material.
Don't shrink mobile explanatory or provenance text to preserve a desktop composition.
Don't add decorative eyebrow labels above the existing headings.
Don't imply contact verification, message delivery, or service availability that the interface has not established.
